title: Run the manager in its own worktree
item: /manage runs in a separate git worktree so the owner can keep working in the main checkout during a run
motivation: The manager switches branches and merges in the checkout where it starts, so today the owner must not work in that checkout during a run
notes: A branch can be checked out in only one worktree at a time, so the working branch cannot be checked out in both. The run marker is already in the git common dir, so the push hook sees it from every worktree.
done_means: /manage creates or reuses a worktree for the run, does all branch switching and merging there, and leaves the owner's checkout untouched; commands/manage.md and SKILL.md say where the worktree is and how the owner reaches the merged work. A test in a temporary repo shows a run's merge lands on the working branch while the main checkout's branch and files are unchanged.
draft_note: Drafted by the manager build on 2026-11-15 at the owner's request. Priority left for the owner. Open choice: where the working branch lives while the owner works (he would stay on another branch, or the run merges with git update-ref instead of a checkout).
